summary: Metric insight shows one number, such as a conversion rate, with its trend line, its change over the chosen range and a one-line note from the agent on what happened. A "Why did it move?" button opens a breakdown of the drivers behind the change.
use: When a dashboard should explain a number as well as show it.
When the agent has found a likely cause, like a release, and you want it marked on the chart.
When people switch between 7, 30 and 90 day views and expect the story to change with the range.
When the agent needs a moment to work out the drivers after someone asks.
features: The chart follows the accent: its line in the accent's mark colour over a faint wash of it.
Each entry in `ranges` has its own `points`, `value`, `change` and `insight`, and a switch picks between them.
The large number and the change tag roll to their new values. The tag turns red when the change is negative.
Hovering the chart shows a guide line and a dot on the nearest point, and the large number shows that point's value.
A range can carry a `marker`, such as a release: a short `tag` like "Sep 18" on the chart, at the top of a dashed guide down through it, with its `label` in a tooltip.

With `drivers`, a button opens a list of what moved the number, each with its share in percent and a bar in the accent on a neutral track. The names tell the drivers apart, so the bars share one colour; give one its own `color`, like a grey for what the agent could not explain.

Set `explaining` while you fetch the drivers. The button says "Looking into it", its words shimmering, and the breakdown stays shut. The button is as wide as its words and eases to each new label. `format` and `formatChange` control how numbers read.
a11y: The range switch is a group labelled "Range" whose buttons use `aria-pressed`.
The breakdown button has `aria-expanded`, and the closed breakdown is `inert` and `aria-hidden`.
The chart SVG is `aria-hidden`, so the number, change and insight text carry the meaning.
With reduced motion turned on, the number and change jump straight to their values.

faq.q: Can I show something other than a percentage?
faq.a: Yes. Pass `format` for the large number and hovered points, and `formatChange` for the tag. The defaults are one decimal with a % and a change like "+8.1 pts".

faq.q: How do I fetch the drivers only when someone asks?
faq.a: Control `open` and handle `onOpenChange`. When it asks to open, set `explaining` to true, load the drivers, then set `explaining` to false and `open` to true. The demo does this.

faq.q: How do I mark a release on the chart?
faq.a: Add `marker: { at, label }` to a range. `at` is a position from 0 to 1 across the chart, and `label` shows when the marker is hovered.
